From 4e10a730d1b511ff49723371ed6d694dd1b2c785 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lorenzo Bianconi <lorenzo@kernel.org>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 20:11:16 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: mt76: Fix possible oob access in
 mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211()

Check frame length before accessing the mgmt fields in
mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211 in order to avoid a possible oob
access.

Fixes: 577dbc6c656d ("mt76: mt7915: enable offloading of sequence number assignment")
Signed-off-by: Lorenzo Bianconi <lorenzo@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260226-mt76-addba-req-oob-access-v1-3-b0f6d1ad4850@kernel.org
[fix check to also cover mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.capab,
correct Fixes tag]
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt76_connac_mac.c b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt76_connac_mac.c
index 3304b5971be0..b41ca1410da9 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt76_connac_mac.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt76_connac_mac.c
@@ -413,6 +413,7 @@ mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211(struct mt76_dev *dev, __le32 *txwi,
 	u32 val;
 
 	if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
+	    skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 + 1 + 2 &&
 	    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
 	    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) {
 		u16 capab = le16_to_cpu(mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.capab);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt76_connac_mac.c` to add a length check before accessing management frame fields in the function `mt76_connac2_mac_write_txwi_80211`. A new condition `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 + 1 + 2` is inserted into the existing `if` statement that processes ADDBA Request frames.

This ensures the skb has enough bytes to safely read `mgmt->u.action.category`, `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code`, and `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.capab`. Without this check, processing a short or malformed frame could lead to an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability. The fix is therefore essential to protect against oob reads when parsing ADDBA Request management frames.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) {
Reason:
The code accesses mgmt->u.action.category and mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code without verifying that the skb is long enough to contain those fields, leading to a possible out-of-bounds read when processing a short or malformed action frame.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
if (ieee80211_is_action(fc) &&
    skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 + 1 + 2 &&
    mgmt->u.action.category == WLAN_CATEGORY_BACK &&
    mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code == WLAN_ACTION_ADDBA_REQ) {
Reason:
The added length check ensures the skb has at least the minimum required size (IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1 for category + 1 for action code + 2 for capabilities) before accessing the mgmt fields, thereby preventing an out-of-bounds access.
